mapper.sql: id, order_no, member_id, product_id, product_revision, fulfillment_kind, gift_recipient_member_id, original_order_id, pay_mode, quantity, unit_cash_price, unit_points_price, total_cash_amount, total_points_amount, currency, product_snapshot_json, quote_sign, quote_expires_at, status, payment_fact_type, payment_fact_id, primary_registration_id, primary_registration_no, registration_ids_json, fulfillment_state, paid_at, refunded_at, revoked_reason, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_product_order (order_no, member_id, product_id, product_revision, fulfillment_kind, gift_recipient_member_id, original_order_id, pay_mode, quantity, unit_cash_price, unit_points_price, total_cash_amount, total_points_amount, currency, product_snapshot_json, quote_sign, quote_expires_at, status, payment_fact_type, payment_fact_id, primary_registration_id, primary_registration_no, registration_ids_json, fulfillment_state, paid_at, refunded_at, revoked_reason, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productRevision}, #{fulfillmentKind}, #{giftRecipientMemberId}, #{originalOrderId}, #{payMode}, #{quantity}, #{unitCashPrice}, #{unitPointsPrice}, #{totalCashAmount}, #{totalPointsAmount}, #{currency}, #{productSnapshotJson}, #{quoteSign}, #{quoteExpiresAt}, #{status}, #{paymentFactType}, #{paymentFactId}, #{primaryRegistrationId}, #{primaryRegistrationNo}, #{registrationIdsJson}, #{fulfillmentState}, #{paidAt}, #{refundedAt}, #{revokedReason}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from marketing_product_order where order_no = #{orderNo} for update

select from marketing_product_order where registration_ids_json is not null and json_valid(registration_ids_json) and json_contains(registration_ids_json, cast(#{registrationId} as json)) order by id desc limit 1
select l.* from marketing_product_order_line l join marketing_product_order o on o.id = l.order_id where o.order_no = #{orderNo} order by l.sort_no asc, l.id asc

select l.topic_id, l.list_amount, l.payable_amount, l.validity_kind, l.valid_days, l.fixed_valid_from, l.fixed_valid_to, l.explore_capacity from marketing_product_order_line l join marketing_product_order o on o.id = l.order_id where o.order_no = #{orderNo} order by l.sort_no asc, l.id asc

select l.topic_id, l.list_amount, l.payable_amount, l.validity_kind, l.valid_days, l.fixed_valid_from, l.fixed_valid_to, l.explore_capacity from marketing_product_order_line l join marketing_product_order o on o.id = l.order_id where o.order_no = #{orderNo} and l.topic_id = #{topicId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_product_order_line (order_id, topic_id, list_amount, payable_amount, validity_kind, valid_days, fixed_valid_from, fixed_valid_to, explore_capacity, sort_no, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{topicId}, #{listAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{validityKind}, #{validDays}, #{fixedValidFrom}, #{fixedValidTo}, #{exploreCapacity}, #{sortNo}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select o.* from marketing_product_order o join marketing_product_item i on i.product_id = o.product_id and i.topic_id = #{topicId} where o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.status = 1 and o.fulfillment_state = 2 order by o.id desc limit 1
select from marketing_product_order where member_id = #{memberId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update marketing_product_order set primary_registration_id = #{primaryRegistrationId}, primary_registration_no = #{primaryRegistrationNo}, registration_ids_json = #{registrationIdsJson}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and primary_registration_id is null

update marketing_product_order set status = 1, payment_fact_type = 2, payment_fact_id = #{factId}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0 and payment_fact_id is null

update marketing_product_order set status = 1, payment_fact_type = 1, payment_fact_id = #{factId}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0 and payment_fact_id is null
